meta.title: Animation Audit Lab | waoowaoo
meta.description: A real interactive comparison of waoowaoo's current motion and proposed improvements.

hero.title: See every motion improvement side by side
hero.subtitle: This is not a static mockup. Both columns run different CSS and interaction mechanics so you can test typing, rapid reversal, stress loops, and reduced motion in place.

purpose.title: 1 · Purpose, frequency, and physical feedback
purpose.description: Frequent actions should respond quickly with restrained movement and one consistent press behavior.

performance.title: 2 · Compositing performance
performance.description: Replace height, left, width, and box-shadow animation during typing and state updates with instant layout or transform / opacity.

interruptibility.title: 3 · Interruptibility and spatial origin
interruptibility.description: Rapid reversals should continue from the current frame. Overlays should emerge from their trigger and own a real exit phase.

accessibility.title: 4 · Reduced motion
accessibility.description: Reduce translation and scale while retaining color, opacity, and state feedback. The control above changes the AFTER column for real.

cohesion.title: 5 · Motion tokens and missed opportunities
cohesion.description: Unify curves, durations, and names, then give modal, sidebar, and skeleton handoffs the same motion language.

hoverPress.title: High-frequency hover and press
hoverPress.description: Current cards scale by 10%, decorative layers take 500ms, and press feedback varies from 90% to 98%. The improved side uses 160ms color/shadow feedback and a consistent 97% press.

textarea.title: Keyboard-driven auto resize
textarea.description: Type into either textarea. The counters record the layout reads and writes actually executed by this page.
textarea.placeholder: Keep typing multiple lines and compare how both sides grow…
textarea.beforeNote: Every key: measure + rAF + height transition
textarea.afterNote: Every key: measure once, commit final height

segmented.title: Segmented control indicator
segmented.description: Change options or enable the stress loop to compare left/width layout animation with a transform-only track.

progress.title: Determinate and looping progress
progress.description: Both sides receive the same value. The current side changes width and chases for 700ms; the improved side changes scaleX and keeps constant motion linear.

loadingNodes.title: Running Canvas node halo
loadingNodes.description: Four nodes run at once. The current side interpolates box-shadow continuously; the improved side keeps shadow static and composites only opacity/transform.

disclosure.title: Reversible Canvas disclosure
disclosure.description: Use rapid reversal to see keyframes restart from endpoints while transitions continue from the current frame.

toast.title: Toast enter, dwell, and exit
toast.description: The current side uses an 800ms keyframe and unmounts immediately. The improved side enters in 180ms, exits in 140ms, and can reverse from its current state.

dropdown.title: Dropdown emerging from its trigger
dropdown.description: Current production animate-in/zoom-in classes have no CSS definition. The improved side uses trigger origin, strong ease-out, and a real exit.

reduced.title: Reduce movement, not information
reduced.description: Enable “Simulate reduced motion” above. The current side keeps moving; the improved side stops spatial motion while state color and fades remain.

tokens.title: One motion token system
tokens.description: The current side shows several near-duplicate curves and durations for the same kind of UI. The improved side uses three explicit semantic tokens.

modal.title: Modal
modal.description: Replace instant mount with centered scale and overlay fade.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Let the panel arrive from its trigger edge instead of appearing suddenly.

skeleton.title: Skeleton → content
skeleton.description: Use a short crossfade and stable card geometry instead of replacing the whole tree.

footer.title: How to judge whether AFTER is actually better
footer.itemA: During repeated clicks, motion should continue from the current visual state instead of replaying from zero.
footer.itemB: Under stress, indicators, progress, and halos should remain coherent on slower devices.
footer.itemC: With reduced motion enabled, translation disappears while success, selection, and hierarchy remain clear.
